reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin for regional signal-based access control and conversation autonomy, including abuse detection, refusal escalation, session termination, optional external network checks, and configurable model-based classification.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 网页配置区域风控、辱骂与严重有害内容判定，并按规则警告、拒绝或结束对话。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that configures regional controls and abuse classification to warn, refuse, or end conversations according to defined rules.

capabilities: Detects browser, locale, timezone, font, proxy, domain, public IP, and WebRTC signals for regional classification
Optionally queries external IP- geolocation services and Google STUN when enabled
Classifies abusive or severely harmful messages using word lists and optional LLM requests
Escalates from warnings or refusals to ending and persistently rejecting a conversation
Injects regional instructions into model prompts and uses formatting variations as hidden markers
Provides a web settings panel and status endpoint
